initial_conditions: Native revision 2 with one curved and marked pattern and one straight holed pattern on Apple Silicon.
actions: Start with an empty native project and inspect both disabled PDF actions in File.
Open the authored revision 2 fixture containing Juniper #2 and Basin #11.
Choose the A4 PDF from File and save to a new destination.
Press Command-K, search for the US Letter pattern PDF and activate it with Tab and Return. Save to a different destination.
Open the A4 export dialog again and cancel. Confirm revision 2 is still active.
Compare the two native files with CLI exports and independently check PDF geometry and page rendering using pypdf and Poppler.
expected_outcomes: File and keyboard exports write six sheets for A4 and Letter with a 100 mm square, actual-size vector patterns and aligned 10 mm overlaps. Saved project bytes match their original.
